description: Basic single-turn research query with synthetic memory data
notes: This task exercises the vector path, which since ADR 0009 is the only retrieval path a run has. trajectory_precision over the node sequence is reported rather than gated because act loops up to maxSteps and every extra iteration lowers it; the tool metrics are reported rather than gated because whether the model reaches for a tool is a property of the model, and the stub set never does. The budgets are per trial and come from P1-I's recording on gemini-3.5-flash-lite of 2026-11-09 (1013 input, 245 output tokens) by P1-F's rule: inputTokens is the recorded input x 1.5 and outputTokens the recorded output x 2, each rounded up to the next hundred, and modelCalls is 2 + maxSteps, the most today's graph can make. Recorded 2026-11-09 on gemini-3.5-flash-lite: 1013 input and 245 output tokens over 3 calls, none of them thinking.
